method: Compile and execute the complete local Guard fence; test boolean configuration, reservation and actual-usage boundaries, valid integer reservation behavior, flow ordering, unique Mermaid node IDs, and documented-versus-inferred checkpoint/source binding. Run the previous independent Guard invariant verifier. No provider, UI or external network calls.

observations.trace: True rejected for step/token/no-change config and reservation/usage; integer reservation accepted; diagram orders preflight < request < usage reconciliation < policy < execution; all Mermaid IDs unique.

limitations: This validates the local teaching Guard and source/diagram consistency only. It does not validate real provider usage semantics, concurrent shared reservations, production authorization, real UI coordinate mapping, sandboxing, audit logging, or business postconditions.
Historical provider/API usage and prior computer-use measurements were not replayed.
